title: 第2章 这是穿越还是穿书呀-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    回到院里，王野仔细打量着自己的家。这是一个一进的四合院，房子的原主是个特务，三年前被绳之以法，房子自然就充公了。

    王铁柱当时也是高瞻远瞩，耗费巨资（1250元）买下了三间正屋，外加两个耳房。虽说花费巨大，但这四合院位于市中心，面积也不小，怎么看都是笔划算的买卖。

    西厢房和西倒座房住的是李奶奶一家。李爷爷是老兵转业回到地方，进了派出所。五年前，他在一次抓特务的行动中英勇牺牲，随后他的儿子李伟顶班儿，顺理成章地成了一位光荣的人民警察。

    经过五年的摸爬滚打，加上李爷爷的余荫，李叔终于熬到了所在地区的派出所所长的位置上。加上李婶和一儿一女，一家五口。李奶奶还有一个女儿李敏在纺织厂上班，三年前已经出嫁。

    东厢房住的是刘叔一家，老刘家可厉害了，一家四个儿子。东倒座房住的是赵爷爷，听说是一个老红军，现在在轧钢厂看大门，无儿无女，是个孤寡老人。

    王野走进正屋，屋内还保留着一些老式的家具，散发着古朴的气息。阳光透过窗户纸洒在地面上，形成一片片光斑。

    没过一会儿，王铁柱和赵爷爷一起回到院里。王铁柱走进堂屋，顺手脱下工作服，挂在门后的衣架上。

    “宝贝女儿呦，想爹爹了吗？”王铁柱边说，边把王野怀里的小丫头抱了过去。也不知道是为什么，这个时代百分之九十九的人家都是重儿轻女。王野家也不知道咋回事儿，女儿是宝儿，儿子好像是大街上捡的一样。

    “别闹了，快点端碗吃饭。”秦婉的声音从厨房中传来。

    这晚饭丰盛得王野都想哭。一人一碗野菜棒子面糊糊，一人一个不知道什么面做的小窝头。唯一的区别是，王铁柱有两个，桌子中间放着一小碗咸菜。

    王野心想：“这能吃饱？不是我吹，就这么大的窝头，我能吃十个。”

    想象很丰满，现实很骨感。吃了第一口，王野就后悔了，这玩意儿拉嗓子。看着手里的窝窝头，菜里面没有一点油。呸，这一点咸菜也配叫菜。吃吧，咬牙也要吃呀，不吃王野就成了穿越大军中第一个穿越一日游的了。

    含着泪吃完手里的窝窝头，屏住呼吸喝了碗里的野菜糊糊。然后，然后就没然后了。还想吃，想吧，使劲想，梦里啥都有。

    现在的家庭主妇，你要说把饭做得多好吃，可能性不大。要是说做得刚刚好，那是炉火纯青。说让你吃半饱，就绝对不会让你吃到六分饱。

    王野家一共五口人，因为是十年前进的城。父母是城市户口，王野是农村户口，是为了多一块儿地，谁知道后来成立了合作社。王野的户口就被卡住了，要想进城得有工作。

    弟弟妹妹出生就在城里，所以两人直接就是城市户口。有人就要问了，咋地，六十年代就有学区房啦？没有，这个真没有，但是要命的是城市户口才有粮本，才能买定量粮。

    成年人每月的供应标准，通常在25斤半到32斤之间。从事重体力劳动的人，如高温、井下作业等，每月供应约40到49斤；轻体力劳动者为29到39斤；机关、团体工作人员和脑力劳动者为27到32斤。

    中学生的供应标准为28到30斤，儿童根据年龄段递减，不满三周岁的儿童每月供应6到11斤。

    少吧？这才哪儿到哪儿呀！今年最新通知，定量下调。王野家现在：父亲的35斤+母亲24斤+小弟15斤+小妹6斤，共计80斤，平均每天每人0.53斤。一天半斤粮食，别说吃饱了，不饿死就谢天谢地了。

    现在正值夏天，在这个年代又没有多少娱乐项目，吃完饭唯一的消遣方式就是门口乘凉。王野一家一起走出大门口。

    王铁柱溜达到棋摊儿，这也是少有的一种休闲娱乐方式。秦婉和一群妇女凑在一起聊起了八卦。弟弟妹妹继续他们的赶蚂蚁大业。王野百无聊赖地坐在了门口的台阶上。

Page (1/3)

Back in the courtyard, Wang Ye looked at his home carefully.This is a first-in-class courtyard house. The original owner of the house was a spy. He was brought to justice three years ago, and the house was naturally confiscated.

Wang Tiezhu was also far-sighted at the time and spent a huge amount of money (1,250 yuan) to buy three main rooms and two side rooms.Although the cost is huge, this courtyard house is located in the city center and has a large area. It is a good deal no matter how you look at it.

Grandma Li’s family lives in the west wing and the west wing.Grandpa Li was a veteran who changed his job and returned to his hometown and entered the police station.Five years ago, he died heroically in an operation to catch a spy. Later, his son Li Wei took over and naturally became a glorious people's policeman.

After five years of hard work and with the influence of Grandpa Li, Uncle Li finally reached the position of director of the police station in his area.Including Aunt Li and her son and daughter, there are a family of five.Grandma Li also has a daughter, Li Min, who works in a textile factory and got married three years ago.

Uncle Liu’s family lives in the east wing. The old Liu family is very powerful, with four sons in the family.The person who lives in the house in the east is Grandpa Zhao. I heard that he is an old Red Army soldier. He is now working as a gatekeeper at the steel rolling mill. He has no children and is a lonely old man.

Wang Ye walked into the main house. There were still some old-fashioned furniture in the house, exuding a simple atmosphere.The sunlight shines through the window paper onto the ground, forming patches of light.

After a while, Wang Tiezhu and Grandpa Zhao returned to the courtyard together.Wang Tiezhu walked into the main room, took off his work clothes and hung them on the hanger behind the door.

"My dear daughter, do you miss your daddy?" Wang Tiezhu said as he took the little girl in Wang Ye's arms.I don’t know why, but 99% of families in this era prioritize children over daughters.Wang Ye's family didn't know what was going on. The daughter was Bao'er and the son seemed to be picked up on the street.

"Stop making trouble, hurry up and get the bowl to eat." Qin Wan's voice came from the kitchen.

The dinner was so sumptuous that Wang Ye wanted to cry.Each person has a bowl of battered wild vegetable sticks, and each person has a small steamed bun made of unknown noodles.The only difference is that there are two Wang Tiezhu, and there is a small bowl of pickles in the middle of the table.

Wang Ye thought: "How full is this? I'm not bragging, I can eat ten of these big steamed buns."

"Imagination is very full, reality is very skinny."After taking the first bite, Wang Ye regretted it. This thing made his throat sore.Looking at the wowotou in my hand, there is no oil in the dish.Phew, these pickles are worthy of being called vegetables.Eat it, grit your teeth and eat it. If you don't eat it, Wang Ye will be the first in the army to travel through time for a day.

With tears in my eyes, I finished eating the steamed buns in my hand, and held my breath as I drank the wild vegetable paste from the bowl.Then, and then nothing more.If you still want to eat, think about it, think hard, you will have everything in your dreams.

For today’s housewives, it is unlikely that you can cook delicious food.If you say it's done just right, then it's perfect.If you are told to eat half full, I will never let you eat half full.

Wang Ye’s family has a total of five people, because it is a city that has been moving forward for ten years.His parents had an urban registered permanent residence, and Wang Ye had a rural registered permanent residence. They wanted to get more land, but who knew they would later establish a cooperative.Wang Ye's household registration was stuck, and he had to have a job if he wanted to go to the city.

The younger brother and sister were born in the city, so they have urban household registration directly.Some people may ask, how come there were school district housing in the 1960s?No, this really doesn’t exist, but the most important thing is that only those with urban household registration have a grain book, so they can buy rations of grain.

The monthly supply standard for adults is usually between 25 and a half kilograms and 32 kilograms.People who are engaged in heavy physical labor, such as high temperature, underground work, etc., need about 40 to 49 pounds per month; light physical workers are 29 to 39 pounds; agency, group workers and mental workers are 27 to 32 pounds.

The supply standard for middle school students is 28 to 30 kilograms, and the supply for children decreases according to age group. Children under three years old are supplied with 6 to 11 kilograms per month.

Less?Where is this?The latest notice this year is that the quota has been reduced.Wang Ye's current situation: father's 35 catties + mother's 24 catties + younger brother's 15 catties + younger sister's 6 catties, a total of 80 catties, an average of 0.53 catties per person per day.With half a catty of grain a day, let alone being full, I would be thankful if I didn’t starve to death.

It’s summer now, and there aren’t many entertainment options in this era. The only way to relax after eating is to enjoy the cool weather outside.Wang Ye's family walked out of the gate together.

Wang Tiezhu strolled to the chess stall, which was also a rare way of leisure and entertainment.Qin Wan and a group of women gathered together to chat and gossip.The younger brothers and sisters continue their great work of chasing away ants.Wang Ye sat on the steps at the door bored.
